COMPUTER STUDIES — MOCK EXAM #3
====

GRADE: Grade 10
SUBJECT: COMPUTER STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

2. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. International Cricket Team
   C. Internal Cooking Timer
   D. Information and Communication Technology

3. When learning Input/Output Devices, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Input/Output Devices.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Input/Output Devices.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Input/Output Devices.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Input/Output Devices.

4. When learning Evolution and Development of Computers, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Evolution and Development of Computers.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Evolution and Development of Computers.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Evolution and Development of Computers.

5. When learning Data communication, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Central Processing Unit.

8. When learning Operating System 1.7 Computer setup 2.0 Computer Networking 2.1 Data communicati, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer set up.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Operating System.

12. When learning Computer storage, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer storage.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Organisation and Architecture.

16. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Ignore burnt cables
